From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC acceptance matrix

Hi Laura / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth going into the trial:

Scope (proposed)
- Integration: Redwood hosted inference endpoint hitting CareX test dataset (anonymized)
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week focused validation + 2-week stress/edge-case run)
- Users: clinical ops + engineering (as discussed)

Proposed acceptance criteria (high level)
- Precision / correctness: >= 92% on the curated validation set (Clinical label agreement)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 450ms on your expected QPS profile
- Safety/hallucination: fewer than 3 critical hallucinations across validation set (definition in attachment)
- Reliability: no more than 2 partial failures per 1k requests

Owners we need from CareX to confirm before kickoff:
- Clinical metric owner (who signs off on labels/thresholds)
- Engineering contact for data ingestion and test env access
- Security contact for the QA review (SOC/Sec controls)

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm owners above and provide contact emails.
2) Share the sample validation dataset (S3 link or drop in shared Drive) by EOW 4/30.
3) Confirm whether the trial should use sandbox keys (recommended) or a VPC/private deployment.

Exec readout request
- We propose an exec-level 30–45 minute readout the week of May 10 to go/no-go and agree next contract step. Proposed time: Tue May 11, 10:00–10:45 PT (we can provide a short decision memo and pre-brief deck). Please confirm availability or suggest a backup slot.

Attachments: trial-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (draft acceptance matrix), poc-kickoff-agenda.pdf (proposed agenda)

I'll follow up with a one-page mutual action plan once owners are confirmed.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0199

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with Engineering and Security:

1) Owners:
- Clinical metrics: Laura Chen (me) — I will own label review and acceptance.
- Engineering lead: Daniel Park (cc) — will coordinate test environment and data ingestion.
- Security/Privacy: Priya Singh (cc) — will handle security questionnaire and data access approval.

2) Dataset: We can share a 2k-record anonymized sample via S3 by 4/29. Daniel will confirm the link by EOD tomorrow.
